body.p: This paper is filed in response to the Restriction Requirement mailed June 20, 2023 (the "Restriction Requirement").
Claims 1-20 are pending in this application. Applicant has amended claims 8, 9, 14, and 18. No new matter is added by these amendments.
The Restriction Requirement has identified three claim groupings:
I. Group 1 - Claims 1-8, drawn to a device with biosensor with two batteries,
one having an anode material coupled to a portion of a distal end of an electrode, classified in A61B 5/14532.
II. Group 2 - Claims 9-13, drawn to a method of activating a device with
biosensor with two batteries, one having an anode material proximate a distal end of an electrode, classified in A61B 5/145.
III. Group 3 - Claims 14-17, drawn to a method of activating a device with
biosensor with two batteries, one having an anode material coupled to a portion of a distal end of an electrode, and an RF transmitter, classified in A61B 5/14507.
IV. Group 4 - Claims 18-20, drawn to a device with biosensor with one battery, classified in A61B5/14503.
Applicant hereby elects Group 1 (Claims 1-8) with traverse. Applicant traverses each restriction requirement for the following reasons.

With respect to Group 2, Applicant has amended independent claim 9 in Group 2 to recite "an anode material coupled to a portion of the distal end of the first electrode," which mirrors the language in claim 1 and served as the basis for the restriction requirement. Restriction Requirement, pp. 2-3. Thus, there remains no basis for restriction and the claims of Group 2 should be part of Group 1.

With respect to Group 3, Applicant has amended claim 14 to eliminate reference to an RF transmitter, which was the basis for restriction. Restriction Requirement, p. 3. Thus, there remains no basis for restriction and the claims of Group 3 should be part of Group 1.
With respect to Group 4, it is not possible to examine claim 1 without
simultaneously examining claim 18 because claim 18 recites the same limitations:
Therefore, Applicant respectfully requests the Examiner withdraw the restriction requirement between Groups 1 and 4. Restriction Requirement, pp. 3.
For these same reasons, restriction as between groups 2 and 3; 2, and 4; and 3 and 4 should be withdrawn.
Should the Examiner have any comments, questions, or suggestions of a nature

necessary to expedite the prosecution of the application, or to place the case in condition for allowance, the Examiner is courteously requested to telephone the undersigned at the number listed below.
Respectfully submitted,
